svg.title: JooBot: the main strands across its versions
svg.desc: Chat and stream automation developed into service and storage experiments, Python quizzes using local models, and a React and Discord quiz interface backed by Convex. Minecraft, video detection and speech synthesis are separate experiments.

g.text: The main strands across the versions
Twitch and Discord commands → Spotify and OBS
Music requests · scenes · camera · AFK · timed replays
Shared commands, separate apps, TypeScript rewrites
SQLite · Drizzle · Bun · Elysia · Next.js experiments
Stored trivia → generated distractors → chat questions
Python · SQLite · Ollama · Twitch Predictions · Astro UI
React quiz interface and Discord quiz interactions
Convex question bank · timers · difficulty · results and streaks
Minecraft bots · video object detection · speech synthesis
